propertyQuotes.evidenceText: Google Hotels returned U.S. Pacific Hotel at 106 Bowery, New York, NY 10013 as a 1-star hotel with $99 nightly and $117 total for 1 night with taxes + fees. The result did not display the required explicit 2 Adults or 2 guests occupancy control, so the numeric quote was not accepted.
propertyQuotes.referencePeriod: Google Hotels result crawled 4 weeks before 2026-08-01; displayed Aug 3-4, one night; occupancy not explicit
propertyQuotes.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels New York City United States 1-star hotel 2 adults price
propertyQuotes.reason: Rejected under the strict contract because the exact-city 1-star result lacked explicit two-adult/two-guest occupancy, despite a direct nightly and taxes-plus-fees display. No unsupported value was substituted.

rejected.reason: No exact New York City 1-star property with an eligible numeric price and explicit occupancy was returned; results were other cities or other star classes.

U.S. Pacific Hotel was again an exact-city 1-star result with $99 nightly and $117 total including taxes and fees, but explicit two-adult occupancy was absent. Other results were 2- to 4-star properties.
